text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Injected transfers at 16 Primary substations, starting in October 2025 and February, April, and June 2026; shapes S2, S3, S4, and S6. Error against the true unmodified power, forecast origins inside the transfer. Plain is the booster on contaminated lags; ceiling is the same booster on lags the transfer never touched. Line: 95% interval.'
